summary: Addentax Group Corp., through its Hong Kong subsidiary Yingxi Industrial Chain Investment Co., Ltd., agreed to acquire 100% of Time Is Loan Limited from sole shareholder Ms. OR Shan Shan (the Seller). Consideration is 137,790 shares of Addentax common stock, valued in arm's-length negotiations supported by a Valtech Valuation Advisory valuation. The board approved the transaction on April 22, 2026. Closing requires Nasdaq notification and customary conditions. This is a stock-for-equity acquisition; watch for Nasdaq listing approval and consummation timeline.
